name: ISK
summary: Sweden's investment savings account. No tax on gains or dividends — instead a small annual tax on the account's average value.

rules.name: Client is a Swedish tax resident
rules.message: An ISK can only be opened for a Swedish tax resident. Client residency: {tax_residency}.
rules.explain: The ISK regime applies to individuals who are tax resident in Sweden (simplified).

rules.name: Instrument is admitted to a regulated market
rules.message: {symbol} isn't admitted to trading on a regulated market or MTF.
rules.explain: An ISK can hold any listed security, fund or cash — including non-Swedish shares.

rules.name: Sufficient cash in the account
rules.message: Not enough cash in the account. Required {required}, available {available}.
rules.explain: Purchases and withdrawals must be covered by cash held inside the wrapper.
